description: Get metrics of a published post. Empty/available=false is not an error (see reason, e.g. NOT_PUBLISHED). A WORDPRESS article has views, users and avgEngagementSec only when its site is linked to Google Analytics (nightly snapshot, up to 48 h behind); otherwise reason GA4_NOT_CONNECTED or GA4_NO_ACCESS (never treat as zero). Requires scope ANALYTICS_READ (the key can only be created by the workspace owner).

channel.description: Channel of the post target, e.g. INSTAGRAM (UPPERCASE canonical, lowercase accepted).

name: get_post_metrics
title: Get post metrics
